sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly woman almost frontal, voluminous silver-grey tight rolled curls swept off forehead with grey brows, small gold round earrings, closed serious mouth, large glossy dark-brown bead necklace. Dark charcoal/olive outer garment with broad pale grey-green satin-like lapel edges over light taupe inner blouse with center seam. Viewer-left lapel has a small round blue/silver badge with unreadable fine white markings. Full painted cool blue background. Preserve curls, brows, earrings, bead necklace, lapel materials, badge and source crop; short broad mascot neck fitted to neckline, no new text.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man, short glossy black side-part hair swept across top and closely cropped sides, thick dark brows, level serious closed mouth. Dark black/charcoal broad-lapel jacket, cream thin-striped pointed shirt partly open at neck, loosened burgundy tie with visible knot near bottom crop. Cool textured blue backdrop. Retain exact side-part, brows, gaze, clothing layers and loose tie configuration, source shoulder crop/light; round mascot head with broad short neck and collar fitted around it.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man with same style short side-part black hair and dark brows, distinct short dark moustache above mouth and short pointed chin/goatee beard with a thin dark jaw fringe. Red/tan/cream/brown argyle V-neck knitted sweater vest over pale cream pointed-collar shirt and dark grey tie. Closed serious mouth, cool blue textured background. Preserve this source's beard and moustache, hair, brows, tie and exact sweater diamond scheme and crop; adapt neckline to short broad mascot neck, without carrying over human nose or flesh ears.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man, short combed black hair swept back with close sides and dark brows. Fine round metal-rim spectacles centered over the eyes. Off-white lab coat with broad folded lapels, grey-blue pointed-collar shirt, dark brown tie, dark brown inner garment at the V. Serious closed mouth and textured blue backdrop. Preserve hair, brows, glasses position, all collar/coat layers, gaze, pose, crop and lighting; use compact round mascot head and short broad neck with fitted coat/shirt shoulders.
